salary_details.details: The Technician (1) post carries Group-C, Pay Matrix Level-2 pay of Rs. 19,900-63,200/-. In addition to basic pay, selected candidates receive Pay and Allowances such as House Rent Allowance (HRA) and Travelling Allowance at Central Government rates applicable to CSIR employees at the place of posting. Other benefits include Leave Travel Concession, reimbursement of medical expenses, and Children's Education Allowance, as per CSIR rules. Accommodation may be provided as per CSIR Residence Allotment Rules, subject to availability (HRA is not admissible where accommodation is provided). New entrants are covered under the National Pension System (NPS). CSIR also offers career advancement opportunities under its Assessment Promotion Scheme for Technical & Support staff.

selection_process: Particulars Details
Mode of Examination OMR-based or Computer-Based Objective Type MCQ
Medium English and Hindi (except the English Language paper)
Standard SSC + ITI / XIIth Standard
Total Questions 150
Total Time 2 hours 30 minutes
Paper Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Negative Marking Time
Paper-I Mental Ability Test (General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Problem Solving, Situational Judgement) 50 100 (2 marks/correct answer) None 1 hour
Paper-II General Awareness 25 75 (3 marks/correct answer) 1 mark per wrong answer 30 minutes
Paper-II English Language 25 75 (3 marks/correct answer) 1 mark per wrong answer
Paper-III Concerned Subject (Trade) 50 150 (3 marks/correct answer) 1 mark per wrong answer 1 hour
Selection for CSIR Technician (1) posts follows a multi-stage process:
Applications received within the stipulated period are screened by a Screening Committee. Candidates recommended/shortlisted by the Screening Committee are invited for a Trade Test
which is qualifying in nature. Candidates who qualify the Trade Test appear for a competitive written examination comprising Paper-I
Paper-II

and Paper-III. Minimum threshold marks for the Trade Test and each paper are fixed by the Selection Committee. Paper-II and Paper-III are evaluated only for candidates who clear the Paper-I threshold. The final merit list is prepared solely on the basis of marks obtained in Paper-II and Paper-III.
The syllabus for the Trade Test and Paper-III (Concerned Subject) will be notified separately on the official CSIR website. In case of a tie in aggregate marks
resolution follows a defined order of precedence: higher marks in the concerned subject/trade paper
fewer negative marks in the concerned subject/trade paper
fewer overall negative marks
older date of birth
earlier date of acquiring the essential degree
and finally alphabetical order of first names.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates must apply online - no other mode of application is accepted.
Visit the website: Go to www.csir.res.in or recruitment.csir.res.in and access the link "Technician (1)" / "Technician - 2026", preferably using Google Chrome.
Register: Click "Apply Online" and register with your name, email address, and mobile number to receive a User ID and password.

Complete your profile: Fill in Gender, Date of Birth, Marital Status, Category, PwBD status (if applicable), Ex-Serviceman status (if applicable), and Govt./CSIR employee status. Once verified and locked, these profile details cannot be changed.
Fill the application form: The form has 6 tabs - Apply, Personal Details, Education, Experience, Additional Details, Uploads, and Preview & Submit.

Upload documents: Scanned photograph (JPG, under 50 KB, 200×150 px), Live Photo Capture, signature (JPG, under 50 KB, 50×150 px), and PDF certificates (each under 1 MB) - proof of date of birth, educational qualifications (10th onwards), experience certificate, caste/disability certificate (if applicable), Discharge Book (if ESM), and NOC from present employer (if applicable).
Pay the application fee: Applicable candidates pay Rs. 500/- online via SBI Collect and upload the e-Receipt/transaction receipt before the closing date.
Preview and submit: Verify all details on the Preview page before final submission, as details cannot be edited afterward. Note the generated Application No. and take a printout for your records.

Candidates applying for multiple post codes must submit a separate application (with separate fee, where applicable) for each post code. e-Admit Cards/Roll Numbers will be issued for the Trade Test/Written Examination; no separate call letters will be posted, and all communications will be published on the CSIR website.

Candidates who have completed 10th with ITI qualifications can explore more 10th Pass Government Jobs and ITI Government Jobs available across India. Candidates interested in technical and support staff positions can also check the latest Group C Government Jobs announced by various Central and State Government departments.

Applicants looking for more opportunities under the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research can browse the latest CSIR Recruitment 2026 notifications across different laboratories and institutes. Candidates seeking jobs in the recruitment locations mentioned in this notification can also explore Delhi Government Jobs, Pune Government Jobs, and Mumbai Government Jobs for similar technical vacancies.

content_sections.heading: CSIR Technician Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: CSIR has notified a total of 43 Technician (1) vacancies, provisional in number and subject to change. Of these, 04 posts are reserved for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) on a horizontal basis, and 02 posts are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - one each under category "b" (Deaf & Hard of Hearing) and category "d&e" (Autism/Intellectual Disability/Specific Learning Disability/Mental Illness, and Multiple Disabilities). Note: The number of vacancies indicated against each post/category is provisional and may increase or decrease at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: CSIR Technician Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For every trade code (260101 to 260110), the essential qualification follows the same pattern - any one of the following: SSC/10th standard or equivalent with Science subjects, minimum 55% marks, plus an ITI certificate or National/State Trade Certificate in the relevant trade; OR SSC/10th standard or equivalent with Science subjects, minimum 55% marks, plus 2 years of full-time experience as an apprentice trainee from a recognised institution in the relevant trade; OR SSC/10th standard or equivalent with Science subjects, minimum 55% marks, plus 3 years of work experience in the relevant trade in a Ministry/Department/Organization/Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Body under the Government of India/State/UT. The relevant trade for each post code is: COPA (260101), Desktop Publishing Operator (260102), Computer Hardware & Network Maintenance (260103), Medical Lab Technician (260104), Draughtsman-Architecture (260105), Instrument Mechanic (260106), Draughtsman-Mechanical (260107), Draughtsman-Civil (260108), Laboratory Assistant in Chemical Plant (260109), and Interior Designer (260110). Educational qualifications must be from a recognised Board/Institution/University, with final results declared on or before the closing date. The upper age limit is 28 years as on the closing date for online applications (17/09/2026). SC/ST/OBC candidates applying against unreserved (UR) vacancies are not eligible for age relaxation. Candidates covered under SC/ST/OBC who also qualify under ESM or PwBD are eligible for cumulative age relaxation under both categories. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. Reservation is available for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen categories as per extant Government of India/CSIR rules. Candidates must possess the requisite certificates in the prescribed format as on the closing date to claim reservation benefits.

rows.relaxation_beyond_upper_age_limit: 03 years after deduction of military service rendered from actual age

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research, under Advertisement No. R&A/01/2026, to fill 43 Technician (1), Group II posts across 10 trades through direct recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 43 total vacancies: UR-19, OBC(NCL)-11, SC-06, ST-03, EWS-04, spread across 10 trade codes (260101–260110). The number is provisional and may change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for CSIR Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 17 September 2026 at 05:00 PM. Applications open on 18 August 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for CSIR Technician (1) posts?
faq.answer: SSC/10th standard with Science subjects and minimum 55% marks, along with an ITI certificate/National or State Trade Certificate in the relevant trade, or equivalent apprentice/work experience as detailed in the Eligibility section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on 17/09/2026, with age relaxation available for SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, departmental candidates, and certain categories of women as detailed above.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for CSIR Technician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Rs. 500/- for general candidates, payable online via SBI Collect. Women, SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from the fee.
